mentions.name: Resurrected hobby operating system
mentions.description: A hobby operating system the author worked on years ago and has now resurrected and released publicly after about 30 years. It is intended to give someone new to OS development a running start and a foundation to build on; the author is undecided whether to continue developing it.
mentions.audience: People new to OS development looking for a running start and a foundation to build on.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I finally collected the courage to release my operating system into the wild:

https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=45400006

I'm super curious if anybody will pick it up and do something useful with it.
